Are you an undergraduate student using Lean? Call for participants – PhD study: Maths proofs in Lean & on paper (1h, £10 voucher)

Hello!  

I’m a PhD student in Mathematics Education at the University of Edinburgh, supervised by Paola Iannone and Athina Thoma.  
I’m currently conducting a study on how undergraduate students interact and understand mathematical proofs both on paper and in Lean. 

Who can participate in this PhD study? 
You are eligible if you: 

  • are currently an undergraduate student 
  • are fluent in English 
  • have experience with mathematical proofs (e.g., completed first–second year compulsory maths courses or equivalent) 
  • have used Lean (e.g., Natural Number Game, Lean 4 web editor, or a local install) 

What you’ll do 

  • One online interview (about 60 minutes) with me 
  • read and discuss mathematical proofs both in Lean and on paper 
  • share your thinking about proofs 
    No preparation is needed; this is not an exam and there are no grades. 

Thank‑you 
I'll share a £10 (or equivalent value in your local currency) voucher after the interview.

Interested? 

  • Please complete this brief form (about 1 minute) 
  • I’ll then email you to arrange a time that suits us both 

Questions? 
Do not hesitate to email me.

Note: this study has been approved by the Ethics Committee at Edinburgh University. 

Thank you for considering taking part! 

Chiara Canclini

Chiara Canclini (PhD student, University of Edinburgh)
